name: Jellyfin / Emby
summary: Plays episodes from your own Jellyfin or Emby server, with its audio and subtitle tracks.
description: Connects Yume to a Jellyfin or Emby server you have an account on and streams the episodes in your own library. The two share an API — Jellyfin forked from Emby and still authenticates with the same X-Emby-Token header — so one extension serves both rather than shipping a near-identical copy. Matches shows by provider id (AniList, AniDB, TVDB, MyAnimeList) when the server knows them, which is exact, and falls back to a title search when it does not. Returns the real stream plus every audio and subtitle track the file carries, so the sub/dub switch and the subtitle picker work on it.

server_url.description: Your Jellyfin or Emby server. Must match the host allowed in this extension's permissions.

api_key.description: An API key from the server: Dashboard → API Keys on Jellyfin, Advanced → API Keys on Emby. Grants access to your library, so treat it like a password.

user_id.description: Optional. Restricts results to one Jellyfin user's view of the library.

max_height.description: Reported resolution ceiling. Direct play ignores it; it only labels the source.

subtitle_format.description: Format Jellyfin converts subtitle tracks to. Browsers only render vtt — change this only if you know why.

allow_transcode.description: Let Jellyfin transcode when the browser cannot play the file directly. Off by default: transcoding is expensive and a direct stream is what most libraries can serve.
